# Dimmed Monokai

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Dimmed Monokai dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Dimmed Monokai (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Dimmed Monokai'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Dimmed%20Monokai.yml).
- Default accent: yellow (#C5A635); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Dimmed Monokai`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme dimmed-monokai
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme dimmed-monokai
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme dimmed-monokai` and `just switch-theme dimmed-monokai` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).
